shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.jsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print | head -50
for f in next.config.ts app/*.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rl "no-store" . | head; grep -rn "cache: 'no-store'" 01-app | head -8
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
